purpose: Independent extension of the frozen human-evidence direction benchmark; no production tuning.
source_policy: Every record is tied to a real PubMed record verified before inclusion.

records.title: Echinaforce and other Echinacea fresh plant preparations in the treatment of the common cold
records.evidence_text: Echinaforce and its concentrated preparation were significantly more effective than the special Echinacea extract or placebo.

records.title: Safety and Efficacy Profile of Echinacea purpurea to Prevent Common Cold Episodes
records.evidence_text: Echinacea reduced the total number of cold episodes, cumulated episode days within the group, and pain-killer medicated episodes.

records.title: Effect of black cohosh on vasomotor symptoms in postmenopausal women
records.evidence_text: There was a significant difference between the two groups in terms of severity and number of hot flashes in weeks 4 and 8.

records.title: Echinacea for treating the common cold: a randomized trial
records.evidence_text: Illness duration and severity were not statistically significant with echinacea compared with placebo.

records.title: Safety and efficacy of black cohosh and red clover for the management of vasomotor symptoms
records.evidence_text: Black cohosh and red clover did not significantly reduce the frequency of vasomotor symptoms as compared with placebo.

records.title: Effectiveness of St John's wort in major depression: a randomized controlled trial
records.evidence_text: In this study, St John's wort was not effective for treatment of major depression.

records.title: Effectiveness of Ginkgo biloba in treating tinnitus
records.evidence_text: Ginkgo biloba extract given 3 times daily for 12 weeks is no more effective than placebo in treating tinnitus.

records.title: Ginkgo biloba for prevention of dementia: a randomized controlled trial
records.evidence_text: G. biloba was not effective in reducing either the overall incidence rate of dementia or Alzheimer disease incidence.

records.title: Effect of increasing doses of saw palmetto extract on lower urinary tract symptoms
records.evidence_text: Saw palmetto extract was no more effective than placebo for any secondary outcome.

records.title: A televised, web-based randomised trial of an herbal remedy (valerian) for insomnia
records.evidence_text: The primary sleep-quality outcome was not statistically significant, while significantly more valerian participants reported their sleep as better or much better.

records.title: Valerian-hops combination and diphenhydramine for treating insomnia
records.evidence_text: Valerian produced nonsignificant reductions in sleep latency, while physical quality of life was significantly more improved than placebo at 28 days.

records.title: A randomized placebo-controlled trial of Ginkgo biloba for the prevention of cognitive decline
records.evidence_text: Unadjusted analyses showed no protection against progression or memory decline, while adherence-adjusted secondary analyses showed a protective effect.
